paragraphs: The M5 CS is the most powerful and focused variant of the F90-generation M5, produced as a limited-run model from 2017 to 2024. Under the bonnet, it uses the S63 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8, part of the S63 family that has powered M5s across the F10 and F90 generations. It's a hot-vee design with the turbos mounted inside the V of the engine, which has a known pattern for rod bearing wear and oil consumption from heat soak. The M5 CS is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

cards.body: A 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the M5 CS from 2017 to 2024 (F90 generation). Known for rod bearing wear and oil consumption from turbo heat soak — see the callout above. We replace timing chains, valve seals, coolant components and bearings as standard on every S63 rebuild.
